description: Event-driven parent-turn completion gate for native Codex subagents.

hooks.command:
python3 -c 'import hashlib, os, stat, sys
from pathlib import Path
source = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = sys.argv[2]
data_root = Path(os.environ.get("PLUGIN_DATA", ""))
if not data_root.is_absolute():
    raise RuntimeError("PLUGIN_DATA must be absolute")
pin = data_root / "runtime" / f"{expected}.py"
try:
    selected = pin
    descriptor = os.open(pin, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0) | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
except FileNotFoundError:
    selected = source
    descriptor = os.open(source, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0) | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
try:
    info = os.fstat(descriptor)
    mode = stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)
    if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.geteuid() or info.st_size > 2 * 1024 * 1024 or (selected == pin and mode != 0o600) or (selected == source and mode & 0o022)):
        raise RuntimeError("hook runtime ownership, type, size, or permissions are unsafe")
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb", closefd=False) as handle:
        raw = handle.read()
finally:
    os.close(descriptor)
if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
    raise RuntimeError("hook runtime digest mismatch")
scope = {"__name__": "__main__", "__file__": str(selected), "__package__": None, "_CODEX_EVENT_GATE_RUNTIME_BYTES": raw}
exec(compile(raw, str(selected), "exec"), scope)
' "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/codex-collaboration-lifecycle.py" "d7afffe8d6851e730b4c3635466a5ae637559ee1dee5b7afb819f3e2163ebd7b"
